mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased wage pressures and reduced corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 1% and UNRATE MoM < -0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -0.5% and UNRATE MoM > 0.1%.
